messages.subject: stat_qq() and grouping variable
parts:
I am struggling with grouping variables in quantile-quantile plots.

In the example below, shouldn't the result be two separate lines,
rather than two connected lines?

qplot(sample = am, data = mtcars, colour = factor(am), geom = "path",
stat = "qq")

messages.subject: Re: stat_qq() and grouping variable
parts:
Thanks.

A few additional problems that seem to be specific to stat_qq():

a) facet_wrap doesn't work with stat_qq
qplot(sample = mpg, data = mtcars) + facet_grid( ~ cyl) # works fine
qplot(sample = mpg, data = mtcars) + facet_wrap( ~ cyl) # Error: nrow
* ncol >= n is not TRUE
qplot(wt, am, data = mtcars, colour = factor(am))+ facet_wrap( ~ cyl)
# works fine

b) shorthand functions xlab & labs don't work with stat_qq
p <- qplot(sample = mpg, data = mtcars)
p + xlab("test_xlab") # x axis label not changed
p + labs(x = "test_labs") # x axis label not changed
p + scale_x_continuous("test") #works fine

--
http://learnr.wordpress.com/
